text.primary: 6-month 1-on-1 coaching for Christians who feel called to write a book but keep starting and never finishing. Weekly calls, a clear plan, daily habits, and accountability until your manuscript is done.

p.heading: You Feel Called to Write a Book. So Why Isn't It Finished?
p.subheading: You can add more detail in this subtitle
p.text:
You've been saying "I'm going to write a book" for years. You've opened the document. Maybe you've written a chapter or two. Then life gets busy, doubt creeps in, and it sits there unfinished. Again.

It's not that you aren't a writer. It's that you've been doing it alone, with no plan, no structure, and nobody holding you to it.

First Author in the Family is 6 months of weekly one-on-one coaching that takes you from "someday" to a finished manuscript in your hands.

p.heading: Your 6-Month Path to a Finished Manuscript
p.subheading: You can add more detail in this subtitle
p.text:
Month 1: The Audit We find where your time, energy, and resources are leaking, what needs to go, and what needs structure, so you finally have room to write.

Months 2 to 4: The Daily Five You build five simple daily habits that rebuild your discipline and your belief: read, listen, journal, set goals, and discipline the body. This is where writing stops feeling impossible.

Months 5 to 6: The Manuscript Push With weekly accountability, we push through to the last page. You leave with a finished manuscript, ready for you to self-publish or take to a publisher.

What you get:

  • A one-hour one-on-one call every week for 6 months

  • A clear writing plan built around your real life

  • Accountability so you stop starting over

  • Help facing the distractions and hidden struggles that keep Christians from finishing what God gave them

11932089.answer: No. You need a story or a message and the willingness to show up. We build the plan and the habits together.

p.heading: You Know You're Meant for More. You Just Can't Figure Out How to Get There.
p.subheading: You can add more detail in this subtitle
p.text:
Every day feels the same. You work, you scroll, you go to bed frustrated, and tomorrow you do it all again. You know God has more for you, but you can't see the next step, and when you do, fear and distraction stop you from taking it.

Being stuck isn't a character flaw. Usually it's no structure, no clarity, and nobody walking with you.

Get Unstuck is weekly one-on-one mentorship that helps you find what's holding you back and start moving again.

p.heading: How We Work Together
p.subheading: You can add more detail in this subtitle
p.text:
First, we find the leaks. Where is your time going? Your energy? Your resources? We look honestly at what needs to go, what needs to stay, and what needs structure.

Then, we build new habits. You'll practice the Daily Five: read, listen, journal, set goals, and discipline the body. Small daily changes that rebuild your belief in what you can do.

Then, you move. As your clarity grows, we take real steps toward what God has put in your heart, with me holding you accountable every week.

Clients have gone from shy and stuck to starting ministries, getting promoted, and leading projects they never thought they could.

$250 a month. One one-hour call every week. We recommend committing to at least 3 months to see real change.

p.heading: How I Lost My Wife to a Warlock
p.subheading: Learn To Thrive After Infidelity, Rebuild Your Life and Choose a Better Spouse by Trey Walters
p.text:
Marriage begins with hope, trust, and the belief that love will last.

But when betrayal enters the picture, everything changes.

How I Lost My Wife to a Warlock is a powerful and honest journey through heartbreak, emotional recovery, and personal rebuilding. This book was written for anyone who has experienced relationship loss, infidelity, or the pain of starting over, and is ready to rise again with clarity and strength.

p.heading: What You’ll Gain From This Book
p.text:
✔ How to recover emotionally after betrayal
✔ How to rebuild confidence after a painful relationship ending
✔ Lessons learned through heartbreak and life transition
✔ How to identify unhealthy patterns and make wiser choices
✔ Practical insight for moving forward with strength and peace

This is more than a story, it’s a guide for rebuilding your life after the unexpected.

p.heading: About the Book
p.text:
This book is part memoir and part practical reflection, sharing the personal experience of entering marriage with a dream, only to face a life-altering reality.

Through transparent storytelling and hard-earned lessons, Trey Walters explores what it means to confront betrayal, process emotional pain, and rediscover purpose after loss.

Whether you are healing from divorce, infidelity, or relationship disappointment, this book offers encouragement and insight for your next chapter.

header.title: 📸 Meeting Readers & Supporters
header.text: Connecting with readers through book signings and events has been one of the most meaningful parts of this journey. Thank you to everyone who has supported this message of rebuilding and restoration.

p.heading: What We Offer at the Restoration Movement
p.text:
The Restoration Movement exists to help people move from broken, stuck, or uncertain seasons into healing, clarity, and advancement.

Everything offered here is designed to support real transformation, not Surface motivation.

p.heading: Mentoring
p.subheading: Mentoring provides wisdom, perspective, and guidance rooted in lived experience.
p.text:
Through Mentoring you receive:

  • Insight from someone who has walked through betrayal, loss, rebuilding, and restoration

  • Personal and spiritual wisdom that helps you avoid unnecessary mistakes

  • Guidance rooted in faith, discernment, and practical understanding

  • Long-term perspective for growth, maturity and purpose

Mentoring is ideal for those who need direction, covering, and wisdom while navigating seasons of transition or rebuilding.

p.heading: Coaching
p.subheading: Coaching focuses on clarity, action, and accountability.
p.text:
Through coaching, you receive:

  • Help identifying what’s keeping you stuck

  • Clear goals and structured next steps

  • Accountability that keeps you moving forward

  • Tools to rebuild confidence, discipline, and consistency

  • Practical strategies for personal, relational, and spiritual growth

Coaching is ideal for those who are ready to do the work, take responsibility, and move forward intentionally.

p.heading: Books & Learning Resources
p.subheading: The Restoration Movement also offers books and teaching resources designed to help you grow at your own pace.
p.text:
These resources address:

  • Marriage restoration and relational health

  • Healing after betrayal and broken trust

  • Sexual discipline and personal integrity

  • Spiritual growth and maturity

  • Breaking cycles and getting unstuck

Each resource is built from experience, biblical truth, and practical application.

p.heading: Community & Accountability
p.text:
This is a space where we walk through the process together, until healing comes, growth comes, recovery comes, and advancement follows.

You are not expected to rush transformation or walk alone.

Here, we stay connected through the journey.

p.heading: Who This Is For
p.subheading: The Restoration Movement is for men and women who are ready to:
p.text:
• Heal honestly and intentionally

  • Grow in faith, discipline, clarity, and strength

  • Rebuild their lives, relationships, and identity

  • Move forward with purpose, clarity and direction

p.heading: Ready to Take the Next Step?
p.text: If you’re ready for healing, clarity, and intentional growth, I’d love to connect with you.

p.preheading: For working parents who are running on empty
p.heading: Pray Every Day In Just 5 Minutes, Even With Long Shifts And Kids
p.subheading: The Impossible Prayer Life: a simple daily prayer plan for busy moms and dads
p.buttonSubtext: Instant download. Start reading on your phone today.

names.primary: The impossible prayer life

text.external:
You love God. You want to pray. But by the time the shift is over, dinner is made and the kids are finally asleep, you have nothing left.

So prayer shrinks into a rushed sentence in the car, and the guilt follows you to bed.

The Impossible Prayer Life shows you how to build a real, daily walk with God in just five minutes, using your own hand as the guide. No app. No quiet room. No extra hours.

  • Fillable prayer maps

  • Scripture cards

  • A 30-day prayer tracker
text.primary: You're exhausted, working long shifts, raising kids, and there's no time left for prayer. The Impossible Prayer Life shows working parents how to build a real, daily walk with God in just five minutes, using your own hand as the guide. No app, no quiet room, no extra hours needed. Includes fillable prayer maps, scripture cards, and a 30-day tracker. What felt impossible becomes your new normal

p.heading: Does this sound like you?
p.text:
• You wake up already behind, and prayer gets pushed to "later."

  • You kneel at night and fall asleep before you say amen.

  • You feel guilty watching other Christians talk about their quiet time.

  • You've tried early mornings, prayer apps and long devotionals, and none of them fit your real life.

  • You miss feeling close to God, but you honestly don't know where the time would come from.

You're not a bad Christian. You were just handed a prayer routine built for someone with free time. You need one built for a working parent.

What changes when you have a plan that fits your day

  • You pray every day, even on the busiest ones, in about five minutes.

  • You never sit there wondering what to say. Your hand walks you through it.

  • You can pray in the car, at the sink, on your break or at bedtime with your kids.

  • The guilt lifts, and you start to feel God close again.

What's inside

  • The 5-minute hand prayer method. One simple pattern you can remember anywhere, with no book open and no app.

  • Fillable prayer maps so your prayers stay focused on what matters to your family.

  • Scripture cards to pray God's Word over your home, your work and your children.

  • A 30-day tracker so you can see yourself build the habit one day at a time.

This is for you if

  • You're a mom or dad juggling work, kids and a full schedule

  • You want a daily prayer life but keep falling off

  • You want something simple you can start today

This is not for you if

  • You're looking for a deep theology textbook

  • You're not willing to give God five minutes a day

The price

The Impossible Prayer Life is $9.99, less than a takeout meal. It's an instant download you can start reading on your phone tonight, and in 30 days prayer can be part of your normal day instead of the thing you keep promising to get to.

Get The Impossible Prayer Life for $9.99

11921972.answer: Yes. It was written for parents with long shifts and full homes. The method takes about five minutes, and you can do it in the car, at the sink or on a break. You don't need a quiet room or an early alarm.
11921972.question: I really don't have time. Will this actually work for me?

11921973.answer: Most prayer routines ask for more time than a working parent has, so they fall apart by week two. This one fits into the day you already have, and the 30-day tracker helps you keep going one small step at a time.
11921973.question: I've tried to build a prayer habit before and quit. What's different?

11921974.answer: That's what the hand method is for. Each finger reminds you what to pray about next, so you never sit there stuck. The prayer maps and scripture cards give you words when you need them.
11921974.question: What if I don't know what to say when I pray?

11921975.answer: It's an instant digital download. After checkout you can read it on your phone, tablet or computer right away, and print the prayer maps and tracker if you like.
11921975.question: How do I get it?
